targeting_context.jd_text:
Manager of Applied AI Architecture, Partnerships
San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY | Seattle, WA

About Anthropic

Anthropic's mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As the Manager of the Partnerships Applied AI Solutions Architect team, you will drive adoption of frontier AI by enabling deployment of Anthropic's products (Claude for Enterprise, Claude Code, API) through our Global and Regional System Integrators, cloud partners (AWS, GCP, Azure), and strategic technology partners.

You will build and lead a team of Partner Solutions Architects, establish processes and best practices for partner-led pre-sales engagements, and represent Anthropic as the technical lead on its most important partnerships. In collaboration with Sales, Partnerships, Product, and Engineering, you will help partners incorporate leading-edge AI into their practices, accelerate indirect revenue, and execute long-term GTM strategy while maintaining our best-in-class safety standards.

Responsibilities

    Team Leadership & Development: Hire, manage, and mentor a team of Partner Solutions Architects. Set goals, run reviews, and coach each team member toward high productivity and career growth.
    Strategic Technical Partnership: Act as the senior technical thought partner to Anthropic's GTM partnerships team. Co-build partner strategy with aligned GTM leadership, drive key programs, and align cross-functional stakeholders (Sales, Product, Engineering) behind partner outcomes.
    Partner Enablement & Ecosystem: Embed your team with GSI and cloud partner technical teams to enable their AI practices, troubleshoot, and evangelize Anthropic in their developer communities. Represent Anthropic at partner events (GSI workshops, AWS/GCP summits, hackathons) and contribute technical content and thought leadership.
    Joint Solution Development: Lead partners in identifying high-value, industry-specific GenAI applications. Develop joint solutions and codify reference architectures and best practices to accelerate time to deployment.
    Customer Deal Support: Own the technical portion of partner-led pre-sales engagements. Intervene directly on strategic deals where partners are the primary delivery vehicle, providing deep solution architecture guidance.
    Product Feedback: Gather and validate feedback on Anthropic's products from partner deployments and deliver it to Product and Engineering to inform roadmap and partner strategy.

You may be a good fit if you have

    7+ years in technical customer-facing or partner-facing roles (Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, Partner SE, TAM).
    3+ years managing pre-sales or partner-facing technical teams; comfortable building foundational teams in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.
    Track record building and scaling partnerships with GSIs (e.g., Accenture, Deloitte, TCS, Infosys) and/or cloud providers (AWS, GCP, Azure).
    Deep understanding of partner-led selling and delivery: indirect revenue models, enablement at scale, and joint GTM motions.
    Technical depth in enterprise AI deployments: LLM architecture, prompt engineering, evaluation, API integrations, and production use cases.
    Exceptional communication and executive presence; able to build trusted relationships with C-suite, partner leadership, and engineering teams alike.
    A love of teaching and mentoring, and a passion for advancing safe, beneficial AI.

Strong candidates may also have

    5+ years leading partner-facing SA teams through hypergrowth, including developing both senior and junior talent.
    Direct experience helping GSIs or consultancies build their AI/ML practice - enablement programs, certification paths, joint solution development.

Compensation

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role's On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary: $315,000 - $380,000 USD

# Anthropic - Manager of Applied AI Architecture, Partnerships briefing packet
| Manager of Applied AI Architecture, Partnerships | $315,000–$380,000 USD | Reports to Partnerships (partner-GTM context) |

## JD Complement
Anthropic’s public posture implies this is not simply a field-architecture leadership need. It is an operating-scale need: converting a safety-centered frontier-model product into repeatable, partner-delivered enterprise outcomes.

The central tension is deployment consistency versus ecosystem reach. Anthropic needs partners to extend technical coverage, industry context, and change-management capacity without allowing solution quality, security practices, or
responsible-use standards to fragment by partner.

## Company DNA & Operating Model
Anthropic is a San Francisco-based public benefit corporation founded in 2021. Its identity is explicitly safety-and-research led, with Claude as its flagship product family.

Its archetype is product-led enterprise AI with a platform-mediated, ecosystem-assisted delivery layer. It wins through the perceived quality, reliability, and trustworthiness of Claude, while partners help translate a general-purpose model
platform into enterprise workflows and industry deployments.

The operating challenge is to preserve a consistent Anthropic implementation standard while external services, cloud, and technology partners increasingly influence how customers evaluate, deploy, and adopt Claude.

## Company Strategy & Operating Pressure
Anthropic’s public-benefit structure is material commercial context. The company is not positioned solely around model capability; it makes reliability, interpretability, steerability, and beneficial deployment part of its institutional
identity.

Claude is presented both as an AI assistant for knowledge work and as an enterprise-grade capability. That creates pressure to make adoption measurable beyond initial access: technical configuration, organizational rollout, enablement, and
scaling all matter to commercial durability.

The decision-rights shift is from one-off technical partnership support toward reusable deployment patterns. Partner motions need enough central governance to protect product feedback loops and implementation quality, while remaining
flexible enough for industry-specific delivery.

## Leadership & Stakeholder Map
Dario Amodei and Daniela Amodei are publicly identified as Anthropic founders and former OpenAI members. Their founding context reinforces the company’s safety-centered identity.

The most consequential internal stakeholder set is likely to include:
- Partnerships and commercial leadership, which need partner capacity and repeatable joint motions.
- Product and engineering teams, which need high-signal deployment feedback rather than isolated feature requests.
- Enterprise adoption and customer-facing teams, which need clear boundaries between product capabilities, implementation guidance, and partner-delivered services.
- Safety, policy, and governance functions, whose standards shape what “good” enterprise deployment looks like.

## AI, Data, Platform, Architecture Signals
Anthropic describes its work as building reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. For enterprise architecture, that means technical positioning must connect capability claims to controls, operational confidence, and responsible
use.

Anthropic’s Claude Enterprise administrator guidance defines deployment as four phases: technical setup; change management and launch; enablement and training; and scaling adoption. This is a strong signal that implementation is treated as
an adoption lifecycle, not a single integration event.

The same enterprise guidance includes Claude Code seat configuration. This suggests that enterprise rollout increasingly crosses business-user and developer-user populations, raising the value of shared administration, enablement, and
governance patterns.

## Partnership / Ecosystem Motion
Anthropic publicly positions its partner ecosystem across cloud, technology, and services partners. The motion is therefore broader than referral relationships: partners can influence infrastructure choice, solution design, implementation,
and adoption.

Accenture publicly presents its Anthropic relationship around enterprise AI deployment, pairing Anthropic’s models with Accenture’s industry and technology expertise. This is a concrete indicator that joint value propositions will need both
technical credibility and vertical relevance.

The key ecosystem operating question is how to turn joint solution work into reusable assets: reference architectures, enablement materials, implementation guardrails, and feedback channels that improve future partner deployments.

A March 2026 report described a $100 million Claude Partner Network commitment, including partner-portal, training, and sales-playbook infrastructure. If sustained, that increases the need for disciplined technical enablement and common
delivery standards across the network.

## Recent Events & Urgency
Enterprise adoption materials now explicitly emphasize change management, training, and scaled usage alongside technical setup. That raises the bar from successful demos to sustained organizational deployment.

The reported Claude Partner Network investment creates urgency around partner readiness. As ecosystem capacity expands, inconsistent technical qualification, uneven solution quality, or unstructured product feedback become more expensive
operating problems.

Competitive pressure in enterprise AI is increasingly about who can operationalize models through trusted cloud, technology, and services channels—not solely who can demonstrate model performance.

## apps_rg Positioning Themes (targeting only, not proof)
- Building repeatable technical plays for partner-led enterprise deployments.
- Translating AI platform capability into governed production architectures.
- Creating partner enablement that spans technical setup, adoption, and scale.
- Balancing solution velocity with security, responsible-use, and quality standards.
- Converting field and partner signals into structured product-roadmap feedback.
- Developing industry-specific solution patterns without creating bespoke-services sprawl.
- Leading technical teams through ambiguous ecosystem and commercialization changes.

## apps_lic Outreach Angles (targeting only, not proof)
- Anthropic’s deployment model appears to treat adoption as a full lifecycle, not an implementation handoff.
- The cloud, technology, and services partner mix makes technical consistency a strategic issue, not merely an enablement task.
- The Accenture relationship is a useful example of the need to combine model capability with industry delivery expertise.
- Claude Enterprise and Claude Code create a shared enterprise-administration and adoption conversation across business and developer users.
- The public-benefit and safety orientation makes scalable implementation governance especially relevant.

## Do Not Use As Proof
The JD and this briefing are targeting inputs only. Candidate claims must come from the governed resume and proof graph.

rubric:
Rubric dimensions (graph-only C0.3 augmented skills graph authority, non-SRFS lane):
1. factual_support: claims supported by allowed_fact_packet and candidate claim_ledger source_fact_ids only.
   **For rows carrying `display_override_text`, the authorized substrate is the UNION of `claim_text` +
   `display_override_text`. Phrases from `display_override_text` are deterministically authorized — do NOT
   flag them as unsupported, inferential, or out-of-scope extensions; the generator was X2-required to emit
   them verbatim. When `graph_proof_refs.claim_support_graph_refs` is non-empty, also authorize prose that
   demonstrates those skill nodes; `graph_proof_refs.source_resume_files` is authoritative provenance.
   Cite a `factual_support` failure only when prose deviates from the full authorized union (claim +
   override + graph skill refs).**
2. executive_signal: SVP-level platform/governance/partner-motion synthesis, not bullet stacks.
3. resume_voice: credible executive prose; no recruiter filler, meta narration, or generic AI-company prose, and nothing that would fail a Head of Talent Acquisition screen.
4. ats_alignment_without_keyword_stuffing: JD shapes emphasis only; no JD-as-proof. When allowed facts
   lack EA/interop/federated proof IDs, penalize only if prose invents those themes or ignores documented
   gap_notes — not for absence alone when generation_law_digest requires gap_notes. Reward company-DNA specificity when the
   packet supports partner ecosystem, adoption motion, commercial fit, or a clean Head of Talent Acquisition screen.
5. anti_overfit: no unsupported metrics/credentials; no target company as candidate experience; no repeated metric inventory
   or company-name mirroring; no AI-authenticity dead giveaways such as em dashes, buzzword soup, or template phrasing.
   **`display_override_text` content is NOT an unsupported credential/metric — it is X2-authorized
   substrate. Do not cite override phrases (e.g. "FSA-chartered", "informing data governance and AI
   strategy at scale") as anti_overfit violations.**
6. synthesis_quality: **exactly six** integrated sentences (X2 band); reward connective SVP IT strategy emphasis when
   ledger-backed; penalize thin recap S6, repeated metric surfaces, and bullet-stacked prose. **Do not** soft-penalize
   credential/metric inventory, unused_fact_ids weave targets, or mechanism dumps when the mapped deterministic gate shows `"pass": true`.
   Keep the cadence human enough to pass a Head of Talent Acquisition screen without machine-generated tells.
7. evidence_utilization: when `x2_exec_summary_evidence_utilization` is `"pass": true`, unused_fact_ids are optional weave
   targets — not proof gaps. Penalize under-use only when that gate is `"pass": false` or synthesis is decisively thin;
   reward distinct evidence themes instead of the same metric repeated in multiple sentences.
8. deterministic_alignment: **only** penalize gates that show `"pass": false` in deterministic_gate_summary. Never cite
   retired five-part/S1–S5 arc mandates when gates passed.

Residual quality (always in scope — not closed by X2 alone):
- executive clarity, narrative coherence, commercial fit, usefulness, unsupported phrasing outside ledger scope.

Decisive failure triggers (must align with deterministic_gate_summary failures when cited):
- unsupported business metric or credential (when x2 gates failed or decisive unsupported claim)
- JD or briefing used as proof
- first-person narrative
- obvious rewrite recommendation that invents new claims
